fullPassage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in.

det.korean: 익숙한(familiar) 광경을 보았다.
det.analysis: fame(명사: 명성) → familiar(형용사: 익숙한): sight를 수식하는 형용사 필요. fame의 형용사형은 famous이지만, 문맥상 '유명한'이 아니라 '익숙한(familiar)'이 적절
det.tip: fame(명성/명사) → familiar(익숙한/형용사). famous(유명한)와 혼동 주의. 원문의 'a familiar sight'에서 familiar는 '친숙한'의 의미.

questions.passage: "Where could it be?" Sophie asked herself. It had been more than ten years since she had last visited the area where she had grown up. The village had changed a lot over time. Uncertain, she awkwardly looked around at her surroundings. She walked the narrow streets of the village, unsure about which way to go. Suddenly, Sophie saw a familiar sight. "Yes, this must be it," she thought. In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it. Although the colors were now faded, the familiar shapes on the wall were the same ones she had painted with her father as a child. Sophie nodded, smiled brightly, and walked toward the gate. __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: She decided to leave the village forever
She realized she was in the wrong place
The house had been demolished years ago
She had at last found the house she had grown up in

det.korean: 마침내 자신이 자란 집을 찾았다(At last, she had finally found the house she had grown up in).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 마침내 자란 집을 찾았다: 원문과 일치하는 결론
❌ ① 마을을 영원히 떠나기로: 집을 찾아 기뻐하는 맥락과 모순
❌ ② 잘못된 장소: 벽화를 인식한 것과 모순
❌ ③ 집이 철거됨: 대문으로 걸어간 맥락과 모순
det.tip: At last = Finally = Eventually: 마침내. 기쁜 결말의 핵심 표현.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: In front of her was a wall with flowers painted on it
She could not remember anything about the place
The streets were completely unfamiliar to her
There was nothing left of the old neighborhood

det.korean: 그녀 앞에 꽃이 그려진 벽이 있었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 꽃이 그려진 벽: 원문 일치, 익숙한 광경의 정체
❌ ② 아무것도 기억 못함: familiar sight와 모순
❌ ③ 완전히 낯선 거리: familiar sight와 모순
❌ ④ 옛 동네가 남아있지 않음: 벽화 발견과 모순
det.tip: "Yes, this must be it" → 꽃 벽화 발견으로 집을 확인하는 흐름
